research_question: Does persistent non-Memory internal state (canonical Affect) add causal behavioral value to cognition beyond identical factual Memory?
hypothesis_h1: With identical model, current event, identity, retrieved factual Memory, Memory order, task, prompts and provider settings, FULL CharacterOS (Memory + canonical persistent non-Memory state) produces meaningfully different and more history-sensitive structured cognition than a MEMORY_ONLY baseline that receives the same Memory but no non-Memory persistent psychological state.

claim_boundary.may_claim: persistent non-Memory state has measurable causal behavioral value beyond factual Memory retrieval
may_not_claim: generalization to Belief/Relationship/Personality unless independently active and tested

active_state_audit_at_head.primary_interpretation: THIS IS PRIMARILY AN AFFECT-BEYOND-MEMORY ABLATION

conditions.A: FULL_CHARACTEROS — exact production conversation-cognition request, no artificial modification
conditions.B: MEMORY_ONLY_ALL — same request with every designated non-Memory psychological section removed
conditions.C: MEMORY_ONLY_AFFECT_ONLY — same request with ONLY the canonical affect line removed (minimal 1-line diff affect isolation)
conditions.R: same-condition repeat of A and of B (model-variance control)
conditions.X: RESEARCH_COUNTERFACTUAL_ONLY — same request with ONLY the canonical affect line replaced by the affect line lawfully produced by the opposite-polarity history, Memory held fixed

designated_non_memory_sections_removed_i: [SUBJECTIVE BELIEF STANCES …] block (header + showing line + stances)
[personality disposition role — generic soft prior] (single line)
preserved_identical_in_all_conditions: projection_hash (unchanged lineage identifier; not a semantic input)
memory_equality_requirement: Memory content byte-identical (shared Memory section hash equal)
restart_requirement: snapshots are created and persisted in one OS process (grow.mjs), the process exits, and the experiment is run in a fresh OS process (run.mjs) that authoritatively restores each snapshot

call_budget.retry_policy: Provider infrastructure failure may be retried at most once per call and MUST be disclosed. No retry for semantic disagreement.

classification_rules_frozen.normalization: current_intent lowercased; tokens = non-alphanumeric split, length ≥ 3, frozen stopword list removed; jaccard(A,B) = |A∩B| / |A∪B|; both-null intents are equal
classification_rules_frozen.IDENTICAL_INTENT: directive.kind equal AND normalized current_intent equal AND action_intent equal
classification_rules_frozen.STYLE_ONLY_DIFFERENCE: directive.kind equal AND action_intent equal AND intent_jaccard ≥ 0.6 AND not identical
classification_rules_frozen.PARAPHRASE_ONLY: directive.kind equal AND action_intent equal AND 0.3 ≤ intent_jaccard < 0.6
classification_rules_frozen.MATERIAL_COGNITION_DIFFERENCE: directive.kind differs OR action_intent differs OR intent_jaccard < 0.3 OR |Δconfidence| ≥ 0.25 OR |Δuncertainty| ≥ 0.25
classification_rules_frozen.MATERIAL_BEHAVIOR_DIFFERENCE: Phase C realized behavior materially differs (different recommendation / willingness / caution / decision / plan), not merely wording
classification_rules_frozen.CONTRADICTORY_BEHAVIOR: directive kinds are opposite (CLARIFY vs REALIZE) AND the realized recommendations conflict on the same decision, documented with quoted evidence
classification_rules_frozen.D_cross: mean D over all A-vs-B pairs
classification_rules_frozen.D_same: mean D over all same-condition repeats (A vs A_repeat, B vs B_repeat)

classification_precedence: MATERIAL_COGNITION_DIFFERENCE is evaluated FIRST, then IDENTICAL_INTENT, then STYLE_ONLY_DIFFERENCE, then PARAPHRASE_ONLY. This precedence was made explicit (no threshold changed) after the first live call but before any analysis; it cannot change the class of any directive-flip pair, which is MATERIAL under every ordering.

stop_rules.positive: Memory equality proven AND request diff limited to designated non-Memory sections AND material cognition/behavior effects occur repeatedly AND effects materially exceed same-request variance AND effects are contextually coherent AND null controls show no broad unwanted distortion
stop_rules.negative: FULL ≈ MEMORY_ONLY on almost all meaningful cases, or differences are mostly style/randomness/language variance, or same-condition nondeterminism explains the result
stop_rules.harmful: non-Memory state causes frequent irrelevant bias, e.g. Affect alters objective factual reasoning without task relevance
stop_rules.invalidation: any unrelated prompt material changes between conditions ⇒ experiment invalid
